notes: Version 2.5 aligns the note with TopologicalInvariants 1.2. The winding of the Hopf phase fibre is invariant for configurations in a fixed fibre or over a trivialising domain of the base, not in the whole fibre S^3, so the former statement that the winding result does not use the chosen domain is withdrawn. The identification of the winding with electric charge is not derived and charge quantisation is listed as open. The Hopf bundle is recorded as the unit monopole bundle over the internal base, whose class makes every fibre winding contractible in the whole fibre; the constituent-paper table lists the fibre winding and, separately, the open charge reading; the charges row cites Q6a only. The bibliography carries the new TopologicalInvariants title.
